title: Verify outputs line
description: One line of the outputs blob of VerifyRun and of the corpus blob of VerifyGenerate and VerifyGenerateAndCheck (the candidates): JSON lines, one object per task, ordered by index, outputs verbatim. Byte-identical for a taskset.

stdout_truncated.description: Present only when stdout hit its cap.

stderr_truncated.description: Present only when stderr hit its cap.

cases.description: Present when the task has a suite: one entry per case, in suite order. The task's own stdout is then empty; each case has its own.

stdout.description: What the program printed in this case, capped by the task's stdout limit.
